parts.text: Give me month on month view of credit card transacted customers and average credit card spends per customer
Monthly breakdown table and trend visualization showing unique transacting credit card customers and average credit card spend per customer over time.
Show me total active loan volume and average interest rate grouped by loan product type
Summary table and chart grouping active loans by product type with total volume and mean interest rate.
What are the top 5 branches by total deposit balances, and what is the distribution across account types?
Ranking of top 5 branches by aggregate deposit balance with account type distribution.
Give me segment wise monthly acquisition trends for new banking customers
Monthly new customer acquisition numbers segmented by customer tier/segment with trend chart.
What is the portfolio delinquency rate across different loan categories over the last 6 months?
Delinquency percentage metrics grouped by loan type across 6 months with risk commentary.
